findings.title: Header bar adds undocumented buy-credits state when succeeded + zero credits
findings.description: The spec (section 2, Structure paragraph) says the header right side shows 'a Regenerate ghost button (when succeeded) or a kebab icon button (otherwise)'. This is a two-state condition with no exceptions. The implementation adds a third state: when status is succeeded AND totalCreditsRemaining is zero, it renders a 'Buy credits' button instead of the Regenerate button. The spec makes no provision for this in the header — the buy-credits pattern is described in the context of zero-state action areas, not the header bar. This is a spec-implementation mismatch in the header's rendered output.
findings.spec_reference: Section 2, Structure: 'The top is a header bar ... with ... either a Regenerate ghost button (when succeeded) or a kebab icon button (otherwise) on the right.'
findings.fix: The header succeeded branch should always show the Regenerate button when status is succeeded. The credit guard (buy-credits fallback) belongs only in the renderCreditsAction helper used by zero-states, not in the header. Remove the `isLoadingCredits || totalRemaining > 0` ternary from the header succeeded branch and unconditionally render the Regenerate Button. If you want to disable Regenerate when loading, use `loading={buttonLoading} disabled={buttonLoading}` on the button itself without switching to a buy-credits fallback.

findings.title: PlatoMark color in FitCard header deviates from spec
findings.description: The spec says the PlatoMark in the FitCard header uses 'colors.gray[700]' with no dark mode variant specified. The implementation passes `color={theme.dark ? theme.color.gray[400] : theme.color.gray[700]}`, adding a dark mode branch that the spec did not include. Per the known failure pattern 'Spec-implementation mismatch is never MED', and the spec's explicit `colors.gray[700]` with no qualification, this is a spec deviation. The spec's intent was a single color value for both modes. The dark-mode substitution to gray[400] (a significantly lighter tone) is an implementation decision that was not reviewed or approved.
findings.spec_reference: Section 2, Succeeded layout item 5: '15px PlatoMark (in colors.gray[700])'
findings.fix: Change line 183 to `<PlatoMark size={15} color={theme.color.gray[700]} />` to match the spec's explicit color. If dark mode handling is desired for this icon, it must be specced first.
